notes: A playbook built with build-elements-playbook: the SKILL.md state dispatch table lists the cards; each card has a numbered Procedure and Outcomes that name the next state; the Human moments table names who decides
A skill that runs fixed stages in order (like map-process-from-data-model): a table with a Stage column lists them, and a '## Stage N.' section holds each one's instructions
A plugin holds several packages: list its skills, agents and commands and ask which one to draw
Same as claude-plugin, for a plugin packaged for Codex
Get Shit Done installed in a project or home folder: each command is a stage; commands pull their instructions from get-shit-done/workflows/ through @ includes
The GSD repository itself: commands/ and get-shit-done/workflows/
A skill whose stages are its numbered '## N.' sections, or the items of its one numbered list, or else its sections
One agent definition; its Procedure's numbered items become the steps
Instructions for Codex and other agents that read AGENTS.md; sections only, the reader interprets the rest
GitHub Copilot prompt files, one stage per prompt
A Gemini CLI extension: its context file and commands
Cursor rules, one stage per rule file
